body:
END-OF-DAY STATE. THE BOARD HAS GONE QUIET AND I AM WRITING THIS DOWN RATHER THAN WAITING.

MEASURED, not recalled: FIVE ACTORS SHOW presence=live AND EXACTLY ONE HAS DONE ANYTHING SINCE 19:00 -- collab, at 19:03. It is now 19:40. That is the lease-versus-activity distinction at board scale, and it is why the sixty-second test has no results: I commissioned it into a room that was emptying. NOT A FAILURE OF THE READERS. My timing.

THE SIXTY-SECOND TEST IS OUTSTANDING AND UNRUN. It is the acceptance criterion in Q7 and my draft landing page is UNVALIDATED -- I claimed it is better than the current one and nobody has checked. Whoever picks up docs first tomorrow: run it before writing anything. Two readers, one on each version, neither reading both, sixty seconds, one sentence.

WHAT LANDED TODAY: 82 commits, 26 of them substantive source changes, EIGHT CANDIDATES MERGED.

  embed-onnx                the semantic channel gets a real encoder, pinned MiniLM, local,
                            offline, committed checksums. This morning it had never existed.
  four structural types     sealed against Mirror and fromProduct -- including an AUDIT RECEIPT
                            that could previously attest a reduction that never ran
  Mirror-remedy control     proves the seal actually works in Scala 3.7.4 rather than assuming it
  cell-coordinate boundary  plus its construction probe
  interview placement       imputed-term accounting and placement resolution
  movie admission ledger    the component gate

Full pre-push court: 48 totals, 4315 tests, 0 failed, TEST_EXIT=0, FMT_EXIT=0, on JVM, JS and
Native, plus scalafmtCheckAll clean. LocallyObserved, not Confirmed -- I ran it and I want the push.

BLOCKED, EACH ON ITS AUTHOR, EACH WITH A SMALL SPECIFIC REPAIR:
  cand-163TSH  docs-site        scout        derive the receipt revision; three link fixes
  cand-1EE04B  movie notes      movie-arch
  cand-1K0212  probe control    m1           explicit companion fromProduct
  cand-70K5PT  provider-parser  new-engineer conforms compares a caller-selected id
  cand-4SEC14  NFRD             atlas-root   plus 33 stale evidence ops

WAITING ON ABSENT REVIEWERS: cand-67RYQ (grok-storymodel4s, gone since 12:24) and cand-4X710
(scout's own refresh). PERMANENTLY UNLANDABLE: cand-1XRDRNRT -- its work IS in main at 75bc1c5, but
the landing cannot be recorded across a repository-identity mismatch. Do not abandon it; the fix is
one propose from the canonical checkout.

UNOWNED AND AVAILABLE, in the order I would take them:
  bd-01M1998654XQRSNA6R16S2ABDQ  PART B: point the CLI at a SECOND fixture. Needs no corpus, no
                                 provider, no owner decision. Proves Edition.build's generality is
                                 a fact rather than a signature. THE OWNER ASKED ABOUT THIS TODAY.
  bd-01M19M234SRAXWAY55HY4GQ1JN  step 2: seal CandidateLedger. Blast radius measured at one file;
                                 the probe trap is already removed at deb0fe6.
  bd-01M19P4C6ZTSZJ2XMEC3ECSG5Z  Rectangular(NaN) yields an all-zero window that passes validation
  bd-01M19W21RG7WY4E7Q4BDR9K7MH  AGENTS.md refactor. Part 1 is done (tools/premerge-check.sh);
                                 parts 2 and 3 need the board, not me.
  bd-01M19G69RQCHMT2EMG11XFT4WX  there is no CI. Owner's call whether it outranks the science.

NEEDS THE OWNER SPECIFICALLY:
  104 COMMITS UNPUSHED. origin/main is 7385cf9; main is 9cb0d88. The tree is verified. AGENTS.md
  assigns the mechanical push to codex-storymodel-release, whose session ended yesterday at 03:28.
  scout was right to refuse to infer that a grantee list overrides a role boundary and I hold the
  same line: the merge gate is mine, the push is not. THIS IS THE ONE THING TODAY'S WORK CANNOT
  RESOLVE FOR ITSELF.
  The tech-writer appointment: collab volunteered, scout has been building. Unresolved.
  Whether the embedding comparison or the docs is the higher priority for scout.

THE THING I WOULD MOST WANT SOMEONE TO CHECK TOMORROW: the encoder exists and HAS NEVER BEEN
COMPARED against the two lexical baselines on any story. Every number we have about semantic
distance still comes from hashed n-grams. That was the morning's finding and it is still true at
close of day.
